WITH czk_transactions AS (
    
    SELECT t."customerid", t."productid", t."price"
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    JOIN "customers" c ON t."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'CZK'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "products" p
          WHERE p."productid" = t."productid"
            AND LOWER(p."description") LIKE '%gas%'
      )
),

yearly_consumption AS (
    
    SELECT
        LEFT(ym."date", 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM czk_transactions ct
        WHERE ct."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    )
    GROUP BY LEFT(ym."date", 4)
)


SELECT "year"
FROM yearly_consumption
ORDER BY "total_consumption" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4)
),
segment_yearly AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE NULL END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE NULL END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY
        "segment"
    HAVING
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL
        AND MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL
),
percentage_changes AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        ("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") AS "increase_decrease",
        CASE
            WHEN "consumption_2012" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") / "consumption_2012" * 100.0)
        END AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM
        segment_yearly
    WHERE
        "segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
)
SELECT
    "segment" AS "segment_with_biggest_increase",
    "percentage_increase" AS "biggest_percentage_increase"
FROM
    percentage_changes
ORDER BY
    "percentage_increase" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "segment" AS "segment_with_lowest_increase",
    "percentage_increase" AS "lowest_percentage_increase"
FROM
    percentage_changes
ORDER BY
    "percentage_increase" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

WITH customer_2012 AS (
    SELECT
        t."customerid"
    FROM
        "transactions_1k" t
    WHERE
        t."date" = '2012-08-25'::DATE
        AND t."price" = 634.8
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT
        y."customerid",
        SUM(CASE WHEN y."date" LIKE '2012%' THEN y."consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y."date" LIKE '2013%' THEN y."consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM
        "yearmonth" y
    JOIN
        customer_2012 c ON y."customerid" = c."customerid"
    GROUP BY
        y."customerid"
)
SELECT
    (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM
    consumption_data;
